summary.text: Yes. CPF says your Singpass contact details were shared so it can update you about CPF matters.

details.heading: Why you received it
details.body: CPF says your Singpass contact information was shared so it can update you about your CPF matters. This is part of a whole-of-government effort to provide a seamless digital experience.

example_phrasings: I received an SMS or email about CPF notifications. Is it legitimate?
Why did CPF contact me through Singpass?
Are CPF notifications sent to my Singpass contact details?

sources.page_title: I received an SMS/email informing me that I will receive CPF notifications via my Singpass registered email address and/or mobile number. Is this legitimate?

quotes.text: Your Singpass contact information was shared with us so that we can update you on your CPF matters in a timely and efficient manner.
